speaker: Doctor
text: I see the test results show elevated urea and creatinine, positive leukocyturia, and a specific finding of 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm on the Cytospin stained with Hansel's Solution. These eosinophils strongly suggest an allergic or parasitic etiology rather than the bacterial infection implied by your history. Please tell me if you have any history of allergies, recent travel to endemic areas, or specific reactions to foods or medications?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: That eosinophilic finding on the cytospin is highly unusual for a typical post-sinusitis bacterial infection. Have you noticed any hives, itching, or swelling since starting your antibiotics? Did you have any recent exposure to seafood or travel to areas with parasitic diseases?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.
